value.rationale: The same one-parameter manifold of least-period-two orbits of a canonical three-dimensional quadratic volume-preserving map supports three qualitatively distinct transverse spectra when κ ε>1, and never all three below that exact parameter barrier. The positive-definite coefficient locus is natural in the original bounded-orbit analysis, and the calculation supplies missing stability organization of a known exceptional period-two family. It is a structural trichotomy with sharp transition points, not a relabeling of the prior observation that exceptional periodic families can exist.
